newsitem.title: USA: Videonics sees Q3 EPS around breakeven.
newsitem.headline: Videonics sees Q3 EPS around breakeven.

text.p: Videonics Inc, a maker of digital video production equipment, said on Monday that it expects third quarter earnings to be "modestly above or below breakeven" due to delayed shipments of key products.
Analysts had expected the company to earn a profit of $0.08 a share for the quarter ending September 30, according to First Call, an investment research group.
"Shipments of PowerScript and Titlemaker 3000 are commencing later in the third quarter than we had anticipated," Jim McNeill, chief financial officer said in a statement.
"Third quarter results are dependent upon manufacturing efficiencies and the number of units of these products shipped."
The company said it has begun shipping PowerScript, a high-resolution standalone PostScript character generator, today at a suggested retail price of $3000, which is lower than competing products.
